arguments.value: This is an outsourcing agreement between Virtual Item Processing Systems, Inc. (VIP) and Brokers National Life Assurance Company (BNL). VIP will provide electronic data processing services for BNL’s insurance policy processing and administration, while BNL must provide compatible equipment and pay the fees and charges listed in the agreement and schedules. VIP keeps the system and software, BNL keeps ownership of its own data, and VIP must protect that data and return it when the agreement ends. The agreement says the initial term is one year starting May 1, 2006, and it automatically renews for one-year periods unless either party gives six months’ written notice before the end of the current term. The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Oklahoma.
